independent_finding:
Independently disassembled; the "secondary-socket descriptor" reading is REFUTED and the candidate text-box finding is CONFIRMED on every point. 0x15b10c (fo 0x5b10c) contains ZERO network ops — its only external calls are word-wrap (0x13f504), signed-divide (0x19f874), bounded-strlen (0x15b448), and vtable alloc veneers (bx r2/bx r3 @ fo 0xa429c/0xa42a0). It is a paged EUC-KR notice-box builder.

STRING SOURCE (HIGH): login entry (fo 0x56c08-21) stores *(r7-8)=node, *(r7-0xc)=*node+8=M, *(r7-0x10)=NET. op=0x3e routes via fo 0x56c7c `cmp r1,#0x3e; b 0x156e6c` (r1=op). Handler fo 0x56ecc-0x56ef2 calls 0x15b10c(r0=obj[alloc 0x14], r1=node, r2=0xc, r3=-1, stack 0x99, stack 9). Inside descriptor fo 0x5b148-0x5b158: r1=*node; P = *node + r2(0xc) + 8 = (M-8)+0x14 = M+0xc = payload[4] = body[2]. So the client reads NO host and NO port — it reads an EUC-KR NUL-terminated notice string starting at body[2].

0x2710 (HIGH): literal lit@0x5b388=0x00002710 loaded at fo 0x5b176, passed as r1 to 0x13f504 where it becomes r8 = the string-index loop bound (`cmp r5,r8; bge exit`, inner fn fo 0x3f570). It is a scan-length sentinel (10000), NOT a port/timeout. Effective text length further capped at 1000 by bounded-strlen 0x15b448 (fo 0x5b478 `cmp counter,max` with max=0xfa<<2=1000).

Word-wrap proof (HIGH): inner scanner fo 0x3f574-0x3f588 does `ldrb str[r5]; ands #0xffffff80` (double-byte EUC-KR lead-byte high-bit test) -> width r6+=0xb, index r5+=2; single-byte branch tests 0x3b(';') and 0x00(NUL). Width limit r7=0x99(153px) triggers wrap. Page math: 0x19f874=__divsi3 (abs/abs + shift-subtract + sign fixup, fo 0x9f874-0x9f8be); caller fo 0x5b186-0x5b194 computes pages=(lines-1)/9+1, so 9=lines/page, 0x99=153=wrap width. Page array alloc size=(pages<<2)+4 via vtable[0x54] (fo 0x5b1e8-0x5b1fe).

Handler behavior (HIGH): op=0x3e (fo 0x56e6c) sends NO reply — full 86-insn body calls only 0x15b390(free prior box), 0x1a42a0(alloc 0x14), 0x15b10c(build box), 0x175cdc(reset); NO put_u8(0x17e150)/flush(0x17e890). It frees+rebuilds NET+0x1a0=box, then `movs r3,#0xd; str [NET,#0x38]` (login state=0x0d). 0x175cdc (fo 0x75d08-0x75d36) memsets NET+0xa0 for 0x100(256) bytes, sets *(NET+0x9c)=arg0(=0), and clears byte at NET+0x461.
